message.content:
Blue denim jeans, straight cut, mid-length knee hem, classic indigo (#2C3E50), sturdy cotton twill with subtle stone-wash finish.
Tan leather sneakers, relaxed silhouette, low-top ankle height, warm cognac (#C19A6B), smooth grained calfskin with vulcanized rubber sole.
Oatmeal structured cardigan, cropped length hitting above hip, boxy fit with button closure, soft cream (#F5EBE3), chunky ribbed knit wool blend.
This look balances her request for jeans with the need for a polished appearance suitable for an autumn date in daylight. The neutral oatmeal and tan tones complement her skin tones while the structured cardigan elevates casual denim into a "neat" style appropriate for a first meeting outdoors. It provides enough warmth for the season without feeling heavy, allowing comfort and confidence as she walks through the park.
